up: Retrieve drug indications recorded at clinical phase 2 for drugs that are fully approved at phase 4. Join molecule_dictionary and drug_indication on molregno. Filter for molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 AND drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind = 2. Output columns: pref_name (drug name), efo_term and mesh_heading (indication terms), and max_phase_for_ind. Return distinct rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, di.efo_term, di.mesh_heading, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 2
